laws.rule: Increased security measures; security checks in major cities are common, so be ready to show photo ID. The government may restrict movement and communications with little warning. People of Uyghur descent are particularly affected.

Entering a border management zone without valid papers (for a foreigner: passport and border management zone pass): a warning, and a fine of CNY 500 to 1,000 (about A$107 to A$213); serious cases CNY 1,000 to 5,000 (about A$213 to A$1,067). Refusing or avoiding a border checkpoint: a warning or a fine up to CNY 200 (about A$43); serious cases CNY 200 to 500. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = CNY 4.6877).

A foreigner entering the border strip (within 2 kilometres of the national border) without approval, or anyone entering a border special control zone without approval: a fine of CNY 2,000 to 5,000 (about A$427 to A$1,067); serious cases CNY 5,000 to 20,000 (about A$1,067 to A$4,266). AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = CNY 4.6877).

Surveying, photography or scientific study in the border strip without reporting first to the border management body and PLA border forces, or outside the area they set: a fine of CNY 5,000 to 10,000 (about A$1,067 to A$2,133); serious cases CNY 10,000 to 30,000 (about A$2,133 to A$6,400). Aerial photography follows national rules. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = CNY 4.6877).

Visitors, tourism businesses and staff are to follow the civil-tourism convention and help keep order and protect tourism resources and the environment (article 8). Scenic areas set visitor-capacity limits and are encouraged to use caps, reservations and off-peak entry (article 59).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.

layers.authority: Public security bureaus at county level or above (border management bodies), Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region
layers.process: Foreigners entering a border management zone in Xinjiang must carry their passport and a border management zone pass (边境管理区通行证), and accept checks. Border management zones are published areas along the border: the border townships and farms, the 2-kilometre border strip, ports, border crossings, cross-border trade zones, border markets and border tourist sites. Foreigners apply at a public security bureau at county level or above; a complete application is processed on the spot, and the pass is free. Children under 16 travel on the holder's pass. People leaving or entering China through a border port inside the zone use their travel documents instead.

layers.authority: Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region border management bodies and PLA border forces
layers.process: Foreigners may not enter the border strip (the land within 2 kilometres of the national border) without approval. Surveying, photography and scientific study in the border strip must be reported in advance to the local border management body and the PLA border forces and kept within the area they set; aerial photography follows national rules. Border special control zones (temporary special-control areas inside a border management zone) may not be entered without approval.
